Maria (CS): Kickoff — Panacea pre-QBR sprint. Saw a 3x token spike last 48h after onboarding week + embed-heavy queries. Need quick triage: is this real usage or test accounts? Also capture enablement gaps.
Jake (AE): @Maria saw that. Panacea renewal in 8 weeks, $75k commit target. Need clean runway + 10% spend reduction ask
Anita (FinOps): Sending initial spend snapshot. Looks like embeddings + rerank stage are main drivers. Forecast for next month if current trend holds: ~$48k -> ~$120k
Ravi (SE): Can we throttle embeddings tier? Proposed quick wins:
- reduce context window for similarity calls
- enable prefix KV caching
- pin to quantized model variant
Lina (Customer): Hey team — we ran a big import last night to onboard prod data, that may be causing the spike. Apologies for the noise.
Maria (CS): Thanks @Lina — useful. Let's separate organic traffic from import. @Ravi can you drop a dashboard filter for 'import_job' tag?
Ravi (SE): On it. Adding a basic filter and creating a short-lived alert. Snippet:
```
alert_name: panacea_embed_rate
expr: rate(requests_total{team="panacea",tag!~"import.*"}[5m]) > 200
for: 10m
```
Maria (CS): Nice. Anita, can you run a 'what-if' for two scenarios: (A) keep import, throttle embeddings 50% (B) postpone import - both impact to next billing
Anita (FinOps): I'll run and post numbers by EOD. Quick ask: what's the commit flexibility? @Jake
Jake (AE): We can propose a 60-day runway extension with a mid-quarter commit review. Will prepare language for QBR
Maria (CS): Also capture enablement feedback from Lina: they said docs on batching were unclear. Lina, can you paste the section you found missing?
Lina (Customer): Sure — the 'bulk-embed' example doesn't show rate limiting or common retry codes. Sent snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
body: {items: [...], model: "open-large"}
# no rate-limiting example
```
Ravi (SE): I'll draft a small README update + example that includes batching and retry backoff. Will tag @docs
Maria (CS): Action items:
1) Ravi: dashboard filter + alert (in prod) — due 2h
2) Anita: scenario numbers and spend forecast — due EOD
3) Jake: commit extension language for QBR — due tomorrow
4) Docs: batching/retry example — Ravi -> PR
If anything else, drop here. :thumbsup:
onboard-bot: Reminder: Panacea onboarding checklist item 'data-import-notify' still open
Maria (CS): Marking as blocked until import schedule confirmed. Lina can you confirm ETA? 
Lina (Customer): We can postpone to next Tuesday 03:00 UTC. That should reduce immediate surge.
Maria (CS): Perfect — we'll reconvene after Anita posts the forecast. Thanks everyone.
